name: hem
title: Hem
description: Search, copy, and manage Hem vault secrets and mesh status from Raycast.
author: trmd

commands.name: search-secrets
commands.title: Search Secrets
commands.description: Fuzzy-find secrets across all scopes; copy values concealed.

commands.name: add-secret
commands.title: Add Secret
commands.description: Create a secret with key/value pairs or .env paste import.

commands.name: cluster-status
commands.title: Cluster Status
commands.description: Per-node mesh health, lag, checkpoints, quorum risk.

commands.name: pending-approvals
commands.title: Pending Approvals
commands.description: Approve or deny pending Hem access requests.

commands.name: scan-clipboard
commands.title: Scan Clipboard for Secrets
commands.description: Check clipboard contents for known secret values before pasting.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Hem Menu Bar
commands.description: Cluster health dot and pending-approval count, always visible.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Operator Token
preferences.description: Leave empty to auto-discover from the standard token file locations.

preferences.name: hemBinary
preferences.title: Hem Binary
preferences.description: Path to the hem CLI, used for cluster commands only.

preferences.name: clipboardClearSeconds
preferences.title: Clipboard Clear (Seconds)
preferences.description: Clear copied secret values after this many seconds. 0 = never clear.

preferences.name: primaryKeyGuess
preferences.title: Primary Key Guess
preferences.description: Ordered, comma-separated key candidates for the Copy Primary Value action.
